================================================================================
MySQL blocks: a procedure with a BEGIN ... END body
================================================================================

CREATE PROCEDURE p (IN n INT)
BEGIN
  DECLARE i INT DEFAULT 0; # the counter; END
  WHILE i < n DO
    IF i = 2 THEN
      SELECT 'END;';
    END IF;
    SET i = i + 1;
  END WHILE;
END;
CALL p(3);

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

(source_file
  (statement
    (comment)
    (string))
  (statement))

================================================================================
MySQL blocks: nested blocks, labels, CASE and loops
================================================================================

create definer = `admin`@`%` procedure q()
outer_block: begin
  declare continue handler for sqlexception begin
    rollback;
  end;
  start transaction;
  case (select count(*) from t)
    when 0 then select case when 1 then 'a' else 'b' end;
    else repeat set @x = @x + 1; until @x > 3 end repeat;
  end case;
  l: loop leave l; end loop l;
  commit;
end outer_block;
select 1;

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

(source_file
  (statement
    (quoted_identifier)
    (quoted_identifier)
    (string)
    (string))
  (statement))

================================================================================
MySQL blocks: a trigger and an event
================================================================================

CREATE DEFINER = root@localhost TRIGGER t BEFORE INSERT ON x FOR EACH ROW
BEGIN
  SET NEW.a = 1;
  SET NEW.b = NEW.a.end;
END;
CREATE EVENT IF NOT EXISTS e ON SCHEDULE EVERY 1 DAY DO BEGIN
  DELETE FROM log WHERE `end` < NOW();
END;
SELECT 2;

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

(source_file
  (statement)
  (statement
    (quoted_identifier))
  (statement))

================================================================================
MySQL blocks: a body with no BEGIN ends at its semicolon
================================================================================

CREATE FUNCTION f (x INT) RETURNS INT DETERMINISTIC RETURN x + 1;
CREATE PROCEDURE g () SELECT a AS b FROM t;
CREATE TRIGGER t2 AFTER UPDATE ON x FOR EACH ROW SET @n = @n + 1;
SELECT 3;

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

(source_file
  (statement)
  (statement)
  (statement)
  (statement))

================================================================================
MySQL blocks: BEGIN outside a stored program starts a transaction
================================================================================

BEGIN;
INSERT INTO t VALUES (1);
BEGIN WORK;
COMMIT;
SELECT begin, end FROM t;

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

(source_file
  (statement)
  (statement)
  (statement)
  (statement)
  (statement))

================================================================================
MySQL blocks: a meta command ends the block
================================================================================

CREATE PROCEDURE r ()
BEGIN
  SELECT :id;
\g
SELECT 4;

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

(source_file
  (statement
    (variable
      (variable_name)))
  (meta_command
    (command_name))
  (statement))
